verdict.rationale: Canny's MCP server lets users 'move ideas through your workflow without leaving your LLM' and 'update statuses, link deals, organize requests' (canny-docs-5), which loosely touches on moving approved feedback toward delivery, but there is no evidence of a formal spec-approval step or integration with engineering delivery tools (Jira, GitHub, Linear) to actually start implementation. Missing for 10: explicit dev-tool/ticket-creation integration, evidence of an approval gate before work begins, and confirmation the MCP action creates implementation-ready tasks rather than just status updates.
